project.name: KINGXFORD Agency Platform
project.objective: Launch a highly legible, distinctive agency platform that turns qualified Canadian organizations into project conversations.
project.audience: Decision-makers in Newfoundland and Labrador first, then Atlantic and national Canadian markets, viewing on desktop and mobile.
project.governing_idea: From fog to focus: a precise cobalt signal travels through every screen and turns complex growth problems into clear action.

creative_system.visual_thesis: North Atlantic realism meets a disciplined signal-house interface: graphite fields, cold cobalt atmosphere, warm practical light and one restrained copper accent.

palette.contrast: Near-black field with large warm-white type, cobalt navigation cues and sparing copper emphasis.

creative_system.composition: Editorial scale, clear focal hierarchy, generous negative space and responsive asymmetric grids.
creative_system.camera: A single stable forward move from Atlantic fog through production and digital work toward a clear harbour horizon.
creative_system.lighting: Cold blue-hour exterior balanced by motivated warm studio practicals.
creative_system.typography: Manrope Variable for display and Inter Variable for body; body copy 18–20px with medium weight and comfortable measure.
creative_system.motion: Scroll-controlled hero playback, restrained reveals, long readable holds and full reduced-motion parity.
creative_system.sound: Silent by design for an accessible, user-controlled website entry.
creative_system.interface: Keyboard-first navigation, high contrast, clear focus states, responsive reflow and honest form status.
invariants: Keep body copy at least 17px on compact screens and 18px on larger screens.
Clearly mark every fictional demonstration concept.
Preserve reduced-motion and poster-image parity for the cinematic opening.
permitted_variations: Crop generated imagery per route while preserving its main subject.
Adapt grid density and motion pacing to viewport and input method.

scenes.title: From fog to focus
scenes.summary: Move from a complex, atmospheric North Atlantic world through KINGXFORD's integrated capabilities to a clear commercial horizon.

shots.purpose: Create a memorable, controllable opening that expresses clarity, integration and Newfoundland roots.
shots.action: The camera travels from Atlantic water through fog into a creative production environment and exits toward a clear harbour horizon.
shots.composition: Continuous centre-safe wide composition with protected copy zones.
shots.camera: Slow, stable forward dolly; no abrupt pan, orbit or handheld shake.
shots.lighting: Cool Atlantic blue hour moving into warm studio practicals and back to a clear cobalt horizon.
shots.motion: Continuous and slow enough for scroll scrubbing with stable geometry between frames.
shots.vfx: Volumetric mist and a subtle cobalt signal line only.
shots.copy: Built at the edge. Designed to move markets.
continuity: Preserve light direction, cobalt signal, camera path and centre-safe layout.

assumptions: English launch first; French expansion pathway is documented but no unsupported bilingual claim is made.
No public office address, phone number, team roster, client list or award list is published until supplied by the owner.
open_questions: Which verified recipient address and sender domain should production inquiries use?
Which commissioned projects can be published after launch?
risks: The inquiry API requires deployment environment variables before email delivery can be enabled.
The bundled hero video increases repository and initial-page transfer size; responsive variants, poster-first rendering and reduced-motion suppression mitigate the cost.
The fallback rate limiter is process-local; sustained or high-risk traffic should use a durable shared limiter or Vercel Firewall rule.
